name: sample
description: Minimal AG-UI chatbot on AWS — AgentCore Runtime + Lambda variants
// pin: Exact versions: every workspace's ^range must resolve to the SAME copy of @strands-agents/sdk + @ag-ui/aws-strands — duplicate copies break TS private-name identity and the adapter's instanceof checks. npm's default hoisted install keeps one copy at the root.

scripts.package: npm run package -w @sample/agentcore && npm run package -w @sample/lambda-web
scripts.synth: npm run package && npm run build:widget && cd infra && npm run synth
scripts.deploy: npm run package && npm run build:widget && cd infra && npm run deploy
